survalent.title: Survalent Technology
paragraphs: Survalent Technology is a leading provider of advanced SCADA and distribution automation solutions for utilities worldwide. My responsibilities included implementing test automation frameworks, optimizing DevOps processes, and developing frontend features using modern web technologies. I collaborated closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of new features and maintain high-quality standards across all projects.

The first artifact is a video demonstrating an automated drag-and-drop test that I implemented for the application. This test showcases how I simulated user interactions within the interface, specifically validating that drag-and-drop functionality behaved correctly under expected conditions. It highlights my ability to design end-to-end tests that go beyond simple input/output validation and instead replicate real user workflows, ensuring that key UI interactions function reliably.

A key challenge in implementing this test was working with locators and ensuring that elements could be reliably targeted in a dynamic UI. In Playwright, drag-and-drop interactions often require more than default commands, especially when elements are rendered asynchronously or lack stable selectors. I had to create custom helper functions to handle cases where elements were not immediately available, as well as refine locator strategies using attributes, text content, and DOM structure to reduce flakiness. Additionally, timing issues, hidden elements, and overlapping UI layers could cause tests to fail intermittently, so I incorporated waits and validation checks to ensure stability. This process reinforced the importance of writing resilient tests that can handle real-world inconsistencies in frontend behavior.

The second artifact is a screenshot of a pass/fail trend graph summarizing test results over the duration of my work term. This visualization demonstrates the progression and stability of the test suite, showing how test reliability improved over time as issues were identified and resolved. It reflects the broader impact of my testing efforts, providing insight into application quality and helping the team track regressions and overall system health.

In addition to improving test stability, I significantly expanded overall test coverage by increasing the number of automated test steps from approximately 1,200 to around 2,100. This ensured that a much larger portion of the application’s functionality was consistently validated through automated testing. By covering these additional scenarios, I reduced the need for repetitive manual testing by QA, saving time and allowing them to focus on more complex exploratory and edge-case testing. This improvement not only increased efficiency but also contributed to more reliable and repeatable validation of the application over time.

high-speed-chase.title: High Speed Chase
paragraphs: High Speed Chase is a 3D multiplayer racing game that delivers an exhilarating gaming experience. Developed with Unity and C#, the game features competitive racing mechanics and has been published on Itch.io.

astro-raiders.title: Astro Raiders
paragraphs: Astro Raiders is a classic 2D shooting game built with Unity and C#. The game features engaging gameplay mechanics and has been released on Itch.io for the global gaming community.

datum.title: Datum: Integrated Learning Platform
paragraphs: Datum is a comprehensive online learning platform specializing in data science education in Japanese. The platform was built entirely from scratch using Ruby on Rails, featuring a complete backend infrastructure and interactive learning components.

wemanage.title: WeManage: Real Estate Asset Management
paragraphs: WeManage is a sophisticated mobile application designed for professional real estate agents in Japan. It provides secure property management, financial forecasting, and income prediction capabilities.

covid-dashboard.title: COVID-19 Case Management
paragraphs: This COVID-19 dashboard was built to provide real-time tracking of cases and vaccination rates for university leadership. The application integrates with Google Sheets API for data management and displays comprehensive analytics.

regression-analysis.title: Multiple Regression Property Analysis
paragraphs: This data science project performs comprehensive analysis of the Japanese real estate market using statistical modeling techniques. It predicts property prices using ordinary least squares (OLS) regression and multiple regression analysis.

programs-of-study.title: Programs of Study
paragraphs: This project involved creating a custom component for a CMS-based platform that helps university students discover and explore academic programs. It was built using Java backend with Handlebars templating and LESS styling.

transfer-evaluation.title: Transfer Evaluation Matrix
paragraphs: This interactive tool assists transfer students in understanding which of their credits will transfer to the university. It features an advanced CSV table generator built with Java and Handlebars templating.

submeowrine.title: Submeowrine
paragraphs: Submeowrine is a 2D shooting game developed for Android devices. It showcases mobile game development capabilities using Java and Android Studio, delivering an engaging user experience on mobile platforms.
